combat_classes.line_combat: Eligible for normal assault/contact according to position, formation and weapon reach.
combat_classes.combat_support: Engineers, sappers, scouts and similar military specialists primarily contribute their specialist capacity. They do not add ordinary line frontage unless explicitly committed or physically caught in contact.
combat_classes.service_support: Medical, logistics and signals are military service units. They are targetable and casualty-bearing but do not add default offensive frontage.
combat_classes.noncombat_support: Students, civilian laborers, dependents and camp followers are noncombat populations unless lawfully mobilized into a real troop type with training/equipment/authority.

capacities.medical: treatment_and_evacuation_capacity = fit medical personnel x Medicine/qualification x medical stores x treatment time x facility/camp quality; it can reduce preventable death/complications but cannot undo anatomy or elapsed time.
capacities.logistics: throughput = fit logistics personnel x transport capacity x route quality x stores available x handling time x security.
capacities.signal: order_relay_capacity and delay depend on fit signal personnel, relay equipment, visibility/range, terrain, disruption and command load.
capacities.engineering: engineering throughput depends on fit engineers/sappers, Engineering skill, tools/materials, work time, site access and enemy interference.

camp_followers: Civilian camp followers/dependents/laborers are supply-consuming noncombat population owners, not military units. Armed train guards are separate homogeneous guard units.
lightweight_service_state: A cold Sword service unit may store support capability plus minimal physical/self-defense state rather than a full line-combat skill array. If it is deliberately converted to a combat role or becomes materially involved in combat, materialize the required capability without granting free skill.
casualty_rule: Support casualties reduce support capacity and remain conserved.
